service: Agent Registry lets callers discover, list, and retrieve approved records published to a registry.

operations.BatchGetDiscoverableRegistryRecord: Retrieves multiple discoverable registry records by ID from a single registry. Records that cannot be retrieved are reported individually in the errors list rather than failing the entire request.
operations.ListDiscoverableRegistryRecords: Lists the discoverable registry records in a registry. You can optionally filter and paginate the results.
operations.SearchDiscoverableRegistryRecords: Searches the discoverable registry records in a registry using a natural language query. Returns metadata for the matching records ordered by relevance.

refs.DiscoverableRegistryRecordSummary$status: The lifecycle status of the registry record. A record is DRAFT before it is submitted, PENDING_APPROVAL while awaiting curator review, and APPROVED once it is approved and discoverable. REJECTED and DEPRECATED records are not discoverable. The CREATING, UPDATING, CREATE_FAILED, and UPDATE_FAILED values reflect the state of an in-progress or failed asynchronous change.
refs.RegistryRecordSummary$status: The lifecycle status of the registry record. A record is DRAFT before it is submitted, PENDING_APPROVAL while awaiting curator review, and APPROVED once it is approved and discoverable. REJECTED and DEPRECATED records are not discoverable. The CREATING, UPDATING, CREATE_FAILED, and UPDATE_FAILED values reflect the state of an in-progress or failed asynchronous change.
